newsitem.title: AFGHANISTAN: Afghan warlord Dostum meets Taleban minister.
newsitem.headline: Afghan warlord Dostum meets Taleban minister.

text.p: Afghanistan's powerful northern warlord General Abdul Rashid Dostum held peace talks with a Taleban government minister on Wednesday, Afghan sources said.

They said Dostum's meeting with Taleban's acting foreign minister Mullah Mohammad Ghaus was also attended by Pakistani Interior Minister Naseerullah Babar and Shi'ite Moslem Hezb-i-Wahdat faction leader Karim Khalili.

The four-hour meeting at Qala-i-Jangi fort outside Mazar-i-Sharif decided to continue the talks on Thursday on the proposed formation of a commission that should decide about the country's political future, a spokesman for Dostum said.
The meeting was the first known high-level contact between Dostum and the Taleban, whose militia captured the capital Kabul on September 27 ousting President Burhanuddin Rabbani's government.
Babar's visit was his second to Mazar-i-Sharif in two days.
Pakistan offered to set up peace talks between the Afghan warring sides after Dostum had aligned himself with Rabbani against the Taleban.
